products.title: Memory Foam Topper
products.body_html:
For all the discomfort you've had to endure sleeping on an uncomfortable mattress, we’ve come up with a solution to transform the way you sleep. Introducing the Sleepyhead Memory Foam Topper, designed to enhance the comfort and durability of your existing mattress without ever replacing it.

This 2-inch Memory Foam Topper is designed to relieve pressure points while providing body-conforming support that helps reduce your muscle pain. It also features High-Resilience (HR) foam, delivering plush comfort with the right balance of support so you can sleep peacefully through the night. The pinhole memory foam technology inside the topper promotes enhanced airflow to keep your sleep surface cooler and fresher every night.

If you share your bed with a partner or a child, the topper's memory foam absorbs motion transfer, minimizing sleep disruptions caused by movement so you get to enjoy a dope, uninterrupted rest.

Wrapped in a premium, luxurious fabric, the topper feels soft for your skin and the anti-skid fabric on the bottom helps keep it securely in place on your mattress. It also has four super elastic corner straps to ensure a snug, stable fit. Simply place it over your existing mattress, secure the straps, and enjoy enhanced comfort without worrying about the topper shifting its place; even if you're busy dreaming dragons, deadlines, or your crush.

Whether you're coming home exhausted after a long day or simply looking for a more comfortable sleep surface, this topper helps reduce pressure points, eases fatigue, and prepares your body for deeper, more restorative sleep. The Sleepyhead Memory Foam Topper is ideal for anyone seeking plush comfort with balanced body support.

products.title: Bamboo Feel Terry Fabric Waterproof Mattress Protector, (78 x 60 inches, Queen Size, Deep Teal)
products.body_html: Introducing the ultimate savior for the bed of the clumsy! Say goodbye to soggy sheets and hello to a dry and cozy night's sleep with our waterproof mattress protector. With a luxurious bamboo feel, you'll feel like you're sleeping on a cloud while also reaping the benefits of our mattress protector's natural moisture-wicking properties. But that's not all! Our mattress protector also features elasticised corners, ensuring a snug fit around your mattress, no matter how much you toss and turn in your sleep. It's the perfect solution for those of you who value comfort and convenience. So go ahead, spill that glass of water or accidentally knock over your morning coffee. With our waterproof mattress protector, you can rest easy knowing that your mattress is protected from any mishaps. It is made from quality fabric that’s hypoallergenic and provides a healthier sleep environment by blocking fluids, moisture, dust mites, bed bugs, and stains from penetrating your mattress. It also helps circulate the air and transport moisture, directly impacting your comfort and sleep. It’s built to last and the moisture-wicking properties will keep it from overheating. The soft, breathable and sweat-absorbent mattress protector with no crinkly noise ensures comfort and reduces irritation to leave you feeling refreshed every morning. The mattress protector is machine washable. It is recommended to wash on a gentle machine cycle and tumble dry on low heat with linens and towels, or you can air-dry. TPU film with terry fabric allows air to pass through but blocks any fluids or liquids from seeping through to the mattress. The moisture-wicking properties of the fabric add to the micro-vented breathable mattress protector. The material is anti-allergenic, so it does not irritate the skin, and it’s durable.
